title: androsace himalaica
intro: Androsace himalaica, commonly known as Himalayan rock jasmine or Himalayan white rose, is a flowering plant species found in the Himalayan region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Androsace himalaica include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and its use as an anti-inflammatory agent to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
